races.paceDynamic: Atlantic City is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead at a sustainable gallop. With most of the field being hold-up horses (First Candidate, Dolly Drama, Flash Bardot, Rose Light, Pink Walls), there's no pressure on the early pace. This creates a stop-start rhythm where Atlantic City can dictate terms before the field comes to life late. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be modest early and the race will become a sprint finish where stamina and tactical positioning matter most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City sets pedestrian fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge in the final three furlongs where class and finishing kick decide the outcome. Hold-up specialists with proven stamina get ideal conditions to unleash their finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Atlantic City Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City gets soft early fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The front runner exploits the lack of early pace pressure to build an unassailable lead. Prominent racers and those who can track the pace early gain the advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If Atlantic City sets steady but honest gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The race unfolds at a fair tempo that doesn't overly favour any particular running style. Form horses with tactical speed and recent fitness edge out those returning from breaks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Challenger
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Grace or another forward horse pressures Atlantic City from the start
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace battle develops early, creating a strong gallop that stretches the field. Late closers with proven stamina benefit from the honest pace.

watchPoints.text: Atlantic City's fitness after 177-day break — if he weakens turning in, the race opens up completely for the hold-up horses
First Candidate's jumping under pressure — has fallen before and needs to be fluent to deliver his strong finishing kick
Cappa Lass and Diamond Grace market moves given their lightly raced profiles and potential improvement from debuts
Charlie Maggs and Shane Quinlan claiming 3lbs on inexperienced apprentices in tactical finish where positioning crucial
Flash Bardot and Pink Walls both returning from lengthy breaks — watch for signs of ring-rustiness in preliminaries

races.paceDynamic: Bucephalus, We're Red And Blue, and Tashan will set a relentless gallop from the start, with three confirmed front-runners ensuring no let-up in pace. The prominent brigade of Dance And Glance, Smart Decision, Frontier Prince, Inedit d'Amour, and Marche d'Aligre will create dangerous congestion through the middle stages, particularly when the field starts to compress approaching the business end. With stamina guaranteed to be at a premium over this extended trip on good ground, the early pace will string out the field and expose horses without the engine to sustain the gallop. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace will set up perfectly for late closers with stamina to sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders maintain a genuine gallop throughout and the prominent pack gets into trouble
scenarios.body: The strong pace will stretch the field and tire the early leaders, allowing the patient hold-up horses to come through with late runs. Williethebuilder and Ice In The Veins have the class and stamina to capitalize on the setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent position perfect
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but one of the prominent runners finds clear running approaching two out
scenarios.body: A horse tracking the leaders in fourth or fifth will get first run on the tiring pace-setters and hold off the late challengers. Smart Decision or Dance And Glance can exploit this tactical advantage with their proven ability at the trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets into a rhythm and the field fails to close the gap
scenarios.body: Despite the expected pace pressure, a front-runner with stamina reserves proves too tough to peg back. We're Red And Blue has shown he can lead and stay, while Bucephalus has the class to sustain his effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and come back to the field quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with the midfield and hold-up horses all converging together. This tactical mess favours horses with a turn of foot rather than pure stamina, bringing the prominent runners back into play.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems in the prominent pack approaching two out - five horses wanting the same position with Dance And Glance, Smart Decision, Frontier Prince, Inedit d'Amour and Marche d'Aligre all needing clear running
Monitor how quickly the three front-runners Bucephalus, We're Red And Blue and Tashan set the early pace - if they go too fast they'll all come back
Keep an eye on Ice In The Veins and Williethebuilder tracking from the back - both have the class to produce late runs if the pace is genuine
Watch Tashan's fitness on his return from 106 days off - he may not be sharp enough to sustain the early pace pressure
Note the impact of the 3lb and 7lb claiming jockeys on Inedit d'Amour, Marche d'Aligre and Bucephalus - the weight relief could prove crucial in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Ernest Gray will take them along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field, creating a measured tempo over this extended trip. The prominent horses like Jakar Du Moulin, I Am Max and Porter In The Park will settle just behind, while the hold-up contingent of Super Survivor, Blue Carpet, Heather Honey, Secret Trix and Walden will be positioned towards the rear. With only one horse committed to making the running, the pace is likely to be steady rather than demanding, allowing the field to stay bunched for longer than ideal. This setup moderately favours prominent racers who can track the lone leader and kick when the tempo lifts, rather than hold-up horses who need a strong pace to set up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray sets a steady tempo and the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means prominent runners can stay closer to the leader without expending energy, positioning them perfectly to strike when the race develops. Jakar Du Moulin and I Am Max are ideally placed to exploit this tactical advantage with their forward-going styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as the prominent horses apply pressure to Ernest Gray.
scenarios.body: A genuinely run race would suit the large contingent of hold-up horses who have been performing well in soft ground conditions. Super Survivor and Blue Carpet have the class and finishing speed to capitalise if the early pace becomes demanding enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Ernest Gray gets an uncontested lead and maintains his stamina advantage over the extended trip.
scenarios.body: With 105 days off, Ernest Gray may have been specifically prepared for this target, and his proven ability at the distance could see him dictate throughout. The lack of pace pressure early could allow him to conserve energy for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a tactical affair where form and ratings count for less than racing luck and positioning.
scenarios.body: Secret Trix has the highest RPR of 146 despite his outsider status, while Walden has been running well in similar company recently. Both could benefit if the favourites fail to handle the pace dynamics effectively.

watchPoints.text: Ernest Gray may not be fully wound up after 105 days off despite being the likely pace-setter, which could compromise the race dynamics
Super Survivor carrying top weight at 10 years old faces a stiff task despite his excellent recent record and weight allowance

races.paceDynamic: Minella Drama will take the field along at a sustainable gallop, with 7 prominent runners creating significant congestion behind the leader. Numitor, Le Milos, Outlaw Peter, Guard Your Dreams, Neon Moon, The Flier Begley and The Widdow Maker will all want to track the pace closely, creating traffic problems and forcing some to race wider than ideal. This crowded mid-pack will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to pick off tired leaders in the closing stages. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace and prominent congestion will string out the field and create racing room late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets into a pace battle tracking Minella Drama
scenarios.body: The pace lifts from 2 out as the crowded pack fights for position, setting up the race perfectly for horses coming from behind. The backmarkers find racing room as the field spreads out and the early pace tells.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-positioned horses avoids the traffic and gets first run
scenarios.body: A horse like Le Milos or Outlaw Peter gets a clean run from their prominent position while others get shuffled back. The Skelton/Cobden partnership proves decisive with superior positioning and timing.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Minella Drama Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader finds no serious pressure and conserves energy
scenarios.body: Minella Drama dictates terms throughout and has enough left to repel late challenges. The pace becomes more moderate than expected, negating the hold-up horses' advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too fast too early and implodes
scenarios.body: The battle for position between the 7 prominent runners creates unsustainable fractions. A rank outsider from the back benefits from the complete meltdown up front.

races.paceDynamic: Victoria Milano and Royal Deeside will contest the early lead, with Victoria Milano likely to dictate given her confirmed front-running style and Jonjo O'Neill Jr's positive booking despite her recent poor form. Count Adhemar, Bonza Boy, and I Shut That d'Or will sit prominent, creating a compact leading group. The hold-up horses Heads Or Harps and Imperial Bede face a tactical disadvantage as the honest gallop will string out the field but may not create the strong pace needed for them to unleash their finishing kicks. This setup moderately favours prominent runners who can track the pace and have the tactical speed to respond when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners set honest pace without going too fast early
scenarios.body: Count Adhemar and Bonza Boy can track the leaders and have the class to strike in the final furlong when Victoria Milano and Royal Deeside tire. Their prominent style perfectly suits this tactical setup with multiple pace angles up front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly searching between Victoria Milano and Royal Deeside
scenarios.body: The field gets strung out dramatically, allowing Heads Or Harps and Imperial Bede to pick off tired leaders with strong finishing kicks. Derek Fox's booking of Heads Or Harps suggests stable confidence in the veteran's ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Setter Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Victoria Milano or Royal Deeside gets an uncontested lead with the other failing to go with them
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate fractions and has enough left to repel challengers, with Royal Deeside's recent winning form and 7lb weight advantage making him the likelier survivor. His good going record (2W3P from 15 runs) supports this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: I Shut That d'Or Returns
scenarios.trigger: If Joe Tizzard has I Shut That d'Or spot-on after 390 days off despite the long absence
scenarios.body: His excellent record (4 wins from last 5 completed runs) and proven class at this level sees him overcome the layoff to strike from his prominent position. Brendan Powell's experience maximizes the comeback effort.

watchPoints.text: Victoria Milano could fold quickly if her 59-day break and recent poor form combine with the pressure of making the running against Royal Deeside.
I Shut That d'Or's 390-day absence is extreme even for a proven performer, watch market support as indicator of Tizzard's confidence in his fitness.
Count Adhemar gets significant weight relief from Theo Gillard's 7lb claim and has been consistent in similar company recently.
Imperial Bede needs the early pace to be genuine between the two front-runners to set up his hold-up style effectively.
Royal Deeside's 7lb weight advantage combined with recent form makes him the more likely pace setter to survive if getting an easy lead.

races.paceDynamic: Kenzo Des Bruyeres will make the running with little pressure early, as most of this field prefer to settle off the pace. Lawtan and Kadjar Des Mottes may track the leader prominently, but five horses (Largy Go, Brookside La, Springtime Legend, Times Are Green, Big Storm Brewing) are confirmed hold-up types who will be content to settle in behind. Over this testing 3m½f trip on good ground, the lone leader will face minimal early pressure but significant late challenges from multiple directions. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the sustainable pace will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages, and the field will compress late with multiple challengers converging.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres sets a steady tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will have plenty left for a sustained finish, with the race becoming a cavalry charge from the back of the field. Multiple closers will sweep past a weakening leader in the final half-mile.

scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres gets easy fractions and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to race prominently and the early pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with stamina less important, potentially suiting horses with higher speed figures regardless of running style. This tactical mess could produce a surprise result from an unconsidered runner.

races.paceDynamic: Saladins Son and One Last Glance will ensure a genuine gallop from the outset, with both confirmed front runners likely to dispute the early lead over this extended 3m1½f trip. The prominent racers like Laganhill, Cerendipity and Ski Lodge will sit just behind this pace, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Major Fortune, Solar System and Jacks Parrot will be looking to pick up the pieces late. With two willing pace-setters and 13 runners, the gallop will be honest throughout, stretching the field and creating plenty of opportunities for closers to pick off tiring leaders. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace is genuine and the field will be strung out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders duel early and compromise each other over the extended trip
scenarios.body: The honest pace will string out the field perfectly for the patient closers, with Major Fortune and Solar System ideally positioned to strike late under top jockeys. The Dan Skelton stable is in excellent form and Harry Skelton's tactical riding will be crucial.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can sit close enough to the pace without getting involved in early skirmishes
scenarios.body: Laganhill or Ski Lodge could get the perfect trip tracking the leaders before mounting a challenge from the last fence. Both have shown they can win from prominent positions and have the class to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Saladins Son can break clear early and control his own fractions without pressure from One Last Glance
scenarios.body: The Anthony Honeyball-trained gelding has won two of his last five and could use his stamina to grind out victory if allowed an easy lead. His recent form suggests he's in good heart despite the 49-day break.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true slog and one of the bigger-priced runners finds extra late
scenarios.body: Jupiter Des Bordes has winning form at this trip and could outrun his odds at a huge price, while If Not For Dylan brings Scottish raiding party confidence. Both have the stamina for this test.

watchPoints.text: Major Fortune's jumping under pressure late - he's prone to the odd mistake when in contention and needs to be clean at the last
Saladins Son's stamina reserves over this extended trip after his 49-day break - may not last home if pressed throughout
One Last Glance and first-time tongue-tie - if the headgear works he could improve significantly but may also over-race early
Jupiter Des Bordes at huge odds with Charlie Maggs claiming 3lb - minimal stable expectations but has the form to outrun his price
The pace battle between the two leaders early - if they go too fast they'll set it up perfectly for the hold-up brigade
